references.phrase: family of objects X_i in category C

references.context: Category theory: injections from each family object to a coproduct object with unique induced map out

references.disposition: A universal map out of the coproduct is specified; do not reverse it to product projections.

review_rationale: Reviewed coproduct as colimit of discrete indexed diagram, with injections X_i→Q and the universal outgoing maps property, not as categorical product or mere set disjoint union in all categories.
